title: World Of Industrialization
description: Have you ever wanted to turn the whole world into a factory? No? This build lets you do it!
body:
Have you ever wanted to turn the whole world into a factory? No? This build lets you do it!

**With our build, you can create factories from mods such as Create, Modern Industrialization, Industrial Upgrade, Applied Energetics 2.**

You can also: send voice messages, rob dungeons, explore new territories, record music, farm, go to heaven and create weapons.

_To diversify the game, when killing monsters, there is a chance to drop a bag with a hat and a set of collectible cards:_

![Collector's card sets and bags of hats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e90fa0030523a5f999f475718572da946375efd0.png)

_A grave will appear at the place of your death:_

![grave stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d74091fe8cd8894c779b84f969b2107397dadbb_0.webp)
